review.ambiguity_note: The quote states flatness without naming its baseline; the prior-year anchor comes from the surrounding 'Fourth quarter highlights, year over year' framing, so the recorded prior_year baseline rests on that framing rather than on the quoted words.

'Restaurant level' can be read either as a population/scope qualifier that stays in the name or as a non-GAAP measurement token; I kept it in the name because it identifies a distinct measured population rather than a measurement version.

The item is readable either as a one-off transaction (action_event, chosen here) or as a recurring reconciliation line level (metric), and the identical amount appears in both the three-month and full-year columns so the period attribution to the quarter is a judgment.
The source states the guide without saying whether it is newly introduced or a revision of a prior guide, so the movement is recorded as unknown rather than introduced.

Chipotlane sits on the name-versus-slice boundary and, if treated as a slice, its kind is plausible under both channel and product with no menu entry to select one, so I kept it in the name and left the slice empty rather than guess a kind.
